parameters.content:
## 📋 Team Management Panel

Actions: Add Team, Remove Team, Active Team, Deactive Team.
Every completed action sends a Vodafone-themed confirmation email.

### Add
Node owner → grouped? (+ interval) → voice path/URL → department → review → confirm → INSERT → email.

### Remove / Deactive
Select active team → confirm → IS_ACTIVE = FALSE → email.

### Active
Select inactive team → confirm → IS_ACTIVE = TRUE → email.

parameters.formDescription: Add or remove & Active or De-active a team in the Automated Calls system

parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM "AUTOMATEDCALLS"."NODE_OWNERS" WHERE UPPER(NAME) = UPPER(:team_name)

parameters.completionMessage:
=

🛑 Team Found

The team {{ $('Normalize Add Data').item.json.node_owner }} already exists (active or inactive). Nothing was added. If it is inactive, use "Active Team" instead.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO "AUTOMATEDCALLS"."NODE_OWNERS" (NAME, IS_GROUPED, GROUPING_INTERVAL, VOICE_FILE_PATH, DEPARTMENT, IS_ACTIVE) VALUES (:name, CASE WHEN :grouped = '1' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END, TO_NUMBER(:interval), :voice_url, :dept, TRUE)

parameters.completionMessage:
=🟢 Team added successfully!

👥 Node Owner: {{ $('Normalize Add Data').item.json.node_owner }}
🔗 Grouped: {{ $('Normalize Add Data').item.json.grouped ? 'Yes – every ' + $('Normalize Add Data').item.json.grouping_interval + ' min' : 'No' }}
🔊 Voice URL: {{ $('Normalize Add Data').item.json.voice_url }}
🏢 Department: {{ $('Normalize Add Data').item.json.department }}

'Yes' : 'No'], ['⏱️ Grouping Interval:', src.grouped ? src.grouping_interval + ' min' : 'N/A'], ['🔊 Voice URL / Path:', src.voice_url], ['🏢 Department:', src.department], ['🕒 Added At:', now]]; const rowsHtml = rows.map(([k, v]) => `${k}${esc(v)}`).join(''); const html = `
🟢 Team ADDED
Automated Calls System – Team Management Panel
${now}
✅ A new team has been added and activated. It will now receive automated calls.
Action Details
${rowsHtml}
Note: This is an automated notification from the Team Management Panel. Changes take effect for the Automated Calls system as shown above.
© ${new Date().getFullYear()} Vodafone. All rights reserved.
IT AI & Automation Software Squad  |  Automated Calls System
`; return [{ json: { email_body: html, subject: `🟢 Team ADDED – ${src.node_owner}`, toEmail: 'TECHIT-AIandAutomationSoftwareEngineering@Vodafone.com.eg' } }];

parameters.completionMessage: No changes were made to the database.

parameters.query: SELECT NAME FROM "AUTOMATEDCALLS"."NODE_OWNERS" WHERE IS_ACTIVE = TRUE ORDER BY NAME
UPDATE "AUTOMATEDCALLS"."NODE_OWNERS" SET IS_ACTIVE = FALSE WHERE NAME = :team_name AND IS_ACTIVE = TRUE
